name: FlowDrop
description: Visual, code-free workflow orchestration for Drupal. Workflows are graphs of typed nodes (AI models, data transforms, HTTP, entity ops, branches) stored as config entities and run by a pluggable execution engine, with pipelines/jobs for audit, human-in-the-loop interrupts, triggers, sessions/memory, and signed importable bundles.

suggests.league/commonmark: Spec-compliant markdown-to-HTML in the Markdown to HTML node; without it a regex fallback is used.
suggests.drupal/key: Enables ${{ secrets.NAME }} references in node configuration, so credentials never land in workflow config or job records.

project_description: Workflow Orchestration for Modern Drupal. FlowDrop is a visual, code-free workflow orchestration module: workflows are graphs of typed nodes assembled in a drag-and-drop editor (inspired by n8n and Langflow) and executed by a pluggable runtime inside Drupal. Where simple event-driven automation hides data flow behind tokens, FlowDrop makes every connection explicit: typed ports, visible edges, traceable executions. The graph is the specification, the execution engine and the audit trail in one. Workflows are standard config entities (export to YAML, version in git, deploy with drush cex/cim). 65+ built-in nodes cover data transformation and dataframes, control flow and gateways, entity queries and saves, HTTP requests, text/markdown processing, AI prompting and tool calling. Three execution modes: synchronous (in-request), asynchronous (queue-based) and StateGraph (checkpointed, resumable execution for chat, loops and long-running flows). Every run produces a pipeline record with one job per node for full audit. Human-in-the-loop interrupts pause workflows for confirmations, choices, forms or free text. Event-driven triggers run workflows on entity changes, user events, cron, or external invocation via the Orchestration module. Sessions, scoped memory and tool-calling nodes give workflows the state agents need. Nested workflows compose automation. Secrets stay out of config with the Key module via ${{ secrets.NAME }} runtime references. Workflows export as Ed25519-signed bundles and import only from trusted publishers. The suite ships ~18 submodules and behaves as a subsystem rather than a single module.
